hud.away: Herder is busy (moving / at sum center)
help.title: Controls
help.body:
WASD / arrows — walk (Shift — run) · click ground — go there
Drag mouse — rotate camera · wheel — zoom
Space — "Khööye!": nearby animals bunch and move away from you
U — take up / put down the uurga (herding pole). With it, animals shy away at 6 m (8.5 m mounted) — walk to steer the herd. Empty-handed, animals ignore you; only "Khööye!" moves them
F — mount / dismount · H — call your horse
Q — scare wolves (45 m, 60 m mounted)
1 / 2 / 3 — speed 1× 2× 4× · G — pasture heatmap · F1 — this help · ` — +50 animals (debug)
Walking near milk cans and wool picks them up (10 units in hand); near the tent they go into storage · E — pick up / store
B — storage & processing · T — cart trip to the sum center (sell, buy)
